method_comparison.official: log-Logistic (generalized logistic type III) with ub-pwm by default

method_comparison.official: package requires nonzero spread and at least 4 observations, checks L-moment validity and may return missing values
method_comparison.classification: intentional alternative plus different failure thresholds; no silent Fisk drops in stored alternative diagnostics

method_comparison.classification: intentional implementation choice, material tail censoring measured below

implementation_defect_review.potential_noncanonical_api_issue: data.build_dataset._standardize_accumulation treats every method string other than 'nonparametric' as the custom shifted-log-logistic branch instead of rejecting unknown names; not active for configured canonical method, not changed in this phase.
important_methodological_limitations: 21 calibration years provide only about 20-21 monthly observations per calendar month.
empirical tail extrapolation beyond the calibration range is linear and the +/-3.5 cap hides further magnitude.
nonparametric SPEI is a valid empirical standardization alternative but is not the conventional SPEIbase log-logistic estimator.

generalized_logistic.reason: Prior 1981-2010 generalized-logistic MLE diagnostics show highly variable/extreme shape estimates, including many values over 100 (near-step CDF behavior); values are not presented as a stable target transformation.

input_data_sources.local_cache_scan: NASA POWER monthly CSV/metadata and 1981 history files are present; no local CRU TS precipitation/PET grids, ERA5-Land, CHIRPS, or GLEAM rasters/time series were found.
